role.description: Exactly one repository role after init

name.description: App / package name set via init --name (defaults by role when omitted)

federationName.description: Module Federation container name derived from name

expose.description: Remote only: MF expose key (PascalCase of name, e.g. ./Checkout)

remotes.description: Shell only: federated remotes loaded by this host

alias.description: Webpack remotes map key / import alias (e.g. demoRemote)

expose.description: Exposed module path (PascalCase of remote name, e.g. ./Checkout)

urlEnv.description: Env var holding remoteEntry.js URL (e.g. DEMO_REMOTE_URL)

remoteName.description: Deprecated: use remotes[]. Still read for backward compatibility

remoteFederationName.description: Deprecated: use remotes[]. Still read for backward compatibility

updatedAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp of last successful init
